requirements.quote: The payload for the UNSUBSCRIBE Packet contains the list of Topic Filters that the Client wishes to unsubscribe from. The Topic Filters in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3, packed contiguously [MQTT-3.10.3-1].
requirements.required_behavior: Treat its fields as the list of Topic Filters the Client requests to unsubscribe.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not treat the listed filters as new subscriptions.
requirements.why_checkable: The payload filters can be compared with the subscriptions removed by the Server.

requirements.quote: The payload for the UNSUBSCRIBE Packet contains the list of Topic Filters that the Client wishes to unsubscribe from. The Topic Filters in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3, packed contiguously [MQTT-3.10.3-1].
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter in an UNSUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode a Topic Filter as arbitrary binary data or another string form.
requirements.why_checkable: Each field can be parsed and validated against the MQTT UTF-8 string rules.

requirements.quote: The payload for the UNSUBSCRIBE Packet contains the list of Topic Filters that the Client wishes to unsubscribe from. The Topic Filters in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3, packed contiguously [MQTT-3.10.3-1].
requirements.condition: When encoding multiple UNSUBSCRIBE Topic Filters
requirements.required_behavior: Pack their UTF-8 encoded string fields contiguously.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not insert padding or unrelated bytes between Topic Filters.
requirements.why_checkable: The end offset of one length-prefixed string can be compared with the start offset of the next.

requirements.quote: The Payload of an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST contain at least one Topic Filter. An UNSUBSCRIBE packet with no payload is a protocol violation [MQTT-3.10.3-2]. See section 4.8 for information about handling errors.
requirements.required_behavior: Include at least one Topic Filter in the payload.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: An empty Topic Filter list is forbidden.
requirements.why_checkable: The parsed Topic Filter count can be checked against the lower bound of one.

requirements.quote: The Payload of an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST contain at least one Topic Filter. An UNSUBSCRIBE packet with no payload is a protocol violation [MQTT-3.10.3-2]. See section 4.8 for information about handling errors.
requirements.condition: When an UNSUBSCRIBE packet has no payload
requirements.error_behavior: Treat the packet as a protocol violation.
requirements.why_checkable: An empty-payload packet can be injected and its protocol-violation path observed.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters (whether they contain wildcards or not) supplied in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be compared character-by-character with the current set of Topic Filters held by the Server for the Client. If any filter matches exactly then its owning Subscription is deleted, otherwise no additional processing occurs [MQTT-3.10.4-1].
requirements.condition: For each Topic Filter supplied in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet
requirements.required_behavior: Compare it character-by-character with the Server's current Topic Filters for that Client, including filters containing wildcards.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not perform wildcard expansion or a non-characterwise comparison for unsubscription matching.
requirements.why_checkable: Known filters differing by a character or wildcard spelling can be submitted and the selected match observed.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters (whether they contain wildcards or not) supplied in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be compared character-by-character with the current set of Topic Filters held by the Server for the Client. If any filter matches exactly then its owning Subscription is deleted, otherwise no additional processing occurs [MQTT-3.10.4-1].
requirements.condition: When an UNSUBSCRIBE Topic Filter exactly matches a current filter for the Client
requirements.required_behavior: Delete the Subscription that owns the matching filter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave the exactly matched Subscription active.
requirements.why_checkable: A later publication or subscription-state query can verify deletion.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters (whether they contain wildcards or not) supplied in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be compared character-by-character with the current set of Topic Filters held by the Server for the Client. If any filter matches exactly then its owning Subscription is deleted, otherwise no additional processing occurs [MQTT-3.10.4-1].
requirements.condition: When an UNSUBSCRIBE Topic Filter has no exact character-for-character match
requirements.required_behavior: Perform no additional processing for that filter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not delete a partially or semantically matched Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: Near-match filters can be tested and existing subscriptions checked for preservation.

requirements.quote:
If a Server deletes a Subscription:
It MUST stop adding any new messages for delivery to the Client [MQTT-3.10.4-2].
It MUST complete the delivery of any QoS 1 or QoS 2 messages which it has started to send to the Client [MQTT-3.10.4-3].
It MAY continue to deliver any existing messages buffered for delivery to the Client.
requirements.condition: After the Server deletes a Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: Stop adding new messages under that Subscription for delivery to the Client.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not enqueue newly matching messages under the deleted Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: Messages published after deletion can be checked against the Client's delivery queue.

requirements.quote:
If a Server deletes a Subscription:
It MUST stop adding any new messages for delivery to the Client [MQTT-3.10.4-2].
It MUST complete the delivery of any QoS 1 or QoS 2 messages which it has started to send to the Client [MQTT-3.10.4-3].
It MAY continue to deliver any existing messages buffered for delivery to the Client.
requirements.condition: After deleting a Subscription when delivery of a QoS 1 message has already started
requirements.required_behavior: Complete delivery of that QoS 1 message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not abandon the in-progress QoS 1 exchange solely because of deletion.
requirements.why_checkable: Deletion during a QoS 1 exchange can be followed through its required completion.

It MAY continue to deliver any existing messages buffered for delivery to the Client.
requirements.condition: After deleting a Subscription when delivery of a QoS 2 message has already started

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not abandon the in-progress QoS 2 exchange solely because of deletion.
requirements.why_checkable: Deletion during a QoS 2 exchange can be followed through its required completion.

requirements.quote:

requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to continue delivering those buffered messages.
requirements.why_checkable: MAY supplies no mandatory choice between delivering and discarding buffered messages.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit the UNSUBACK response.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives an UNSUBSCRIBE packet that contains multiple Topic Filters it MUST handle that packet as if it had received a sequence of multiple UNSUBSCRIBE packets, except that it sends just one UNSUBACK response [MQTT-3.10.4-6].

	0	0	0	0	0	0	0	0
requirements.required_behavior: Encode Remaining Length as the single-byte value 0 at byte 2.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode a nonzero Remaining Length.
requirements.why_checkable: Byte 2 can be compared directly with 0x00.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST validate that reserved bits are set to zero and disconnect the Client if they are not zero [MQTT-3.14.1-1].
requirements.required_behavior: Validate that every reserved fixed-header bit is 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not accept the reserved bits without validation.
requirements.why_checkable: Each reserved bit can be toggled and the validation result observed.

requirements.why_checkable: Each invalid flag pattern can be injected and connection termination observed.

requirements.quote: The DISCONNECT Packet has no variable header.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include a variable header.
requirements.why_checkable: No variable-header bytes may follow Remaining Length.

requirements.quote: The DISCONNECT Packet has no payload.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include a payload.
requirements.why_checkable: No payload bytes may follow the fixed header.

requirements.why_checkable: The post-DISCONNECT outbound packet trace can be checked for silence.
